workflow_pattern: This is a 'F7_pure_automation' style workflow. It requires the following operations, in roughly this order: create repository, add readme with content, create workflow conditional comment by label, validate automation with test issues. The task should combine these operations into one coherent, realistic request without listing them as separate steps.
question:
Hi! Can you please help me make a super cool project repository called support-ticket-bot? I want to start it with just the main branch! Oh, and can we put a special README.md file in it that says "# Support Ticket Bot

A repository to test GitHub automation for adding comments to issues."? That would be awesome! Then, I really really want to make a GitHub robot that watches for new issues and says different things based on what kind of issue it is! If someone makes an issue with a billing label, I want the robot to say "Thanks, our billing team will look into this shortly.", and if they make one with a technical label, I want it to say "Thanks, our technical support team will investigate." If no label is assigned, the robot should say "Thanks for reaching out, we'll route this to the right team." After we build the robot, can we test it by making three pretend issues? The first one should be called "Charged twice this month" and have a billing label, the second one should be "App crashes on login" with a technical label, and the third one should be "General question about pricing" but with no label at all! This is going to be so much fun!
